answer: Each identity locks a 90-credit bond at a haven post and sends a pulse heartbeat each epoch: a zephyr wind reading plus a work receipt. A random beacon spot-checks 5%; auditors replay each pulse against the haven zephyr table. A pulse off by over 3%, reused, or missed burns the bond. First pays 42, k-th 42+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,039,000 plus 90,000 locked. The named failure is a rented-pulse ring. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeps its bond.
